answer: Something you know (your password) and something you have (your phone).
The thief has the password but not the phone, so does not get the code the site sends to the phone. One stolen key is not enough; they would need both.
A box labelled 'Thief's login' appeared under the thief and the site, then a 'Still locked' box replaced it: the login did not get in and stayed locked.
No notice was shown in the clip. (The narration and a 'code' label said the site sends a code to your phone.)
